description.en: Three synchronized dot grids form expanding two-color ripples, a rotating spiral, and a growing circular pulse on printed cards.
description.zh: 三张点阵卡片同步呈现双色扩散波纹、旋转旋涡与圆形扩张，保留印刷排版和渐变背景。

keywords: 点阵 波纹 旋涡 漩涡 圆形 扩散 三联 卡片 LeiBox 雷师傅 Chris Halaska dot matrix ripple spiral pulse

discovery.caveat: 三联卡片视觉；等待反馈可优先比较 ai-generating。

instructions.en: Click or tap a card to pause or resume all three patterns. Use Enter or Space when focused, arrow keys to step, and Home or Escape to reset.
instructions.zh: 点击或轻触任一卡片暂停、继续三组动效。聚焦后可按回车或空格切换，方向键逐帧查看，Home 或 Escape 重置。
